action.description: Action to perform: generate (create new media), regenerate (new image at existing slot URL), list_slots (list all slots), get_slot (get slot details)

prompt.description: Text description of the desired media. Required for generate. Optional for regenerate (reuses last prompt if omitted).

content_type.description: Type of media to generate. Default: image. 'infographic' uses an optimal model for data-driven infographic visuals. 'image_proxy' downloads and re-serves an external image via builder2 CDN (requires image_url). 'page_screenshot' renders a webpage via headless Chromium and captures a screenshot (requires page_url). 'transcribe' transcribes an audio/video URL to text with timestamps (requires audio_url).

media_slug.description: URL-friendly name for the media (auto-slugified from prompt if omitted). Used to construct the permanent CDN URL.

count.description: Number of variants to generate (1-4, default 1).

image_size.description: Image aspect ratio preset (image only). The closest supported value is chosen per model.

character_id.description: Generate with a character's traits (physical & soul) automatically injected into the prompt.

character_slug.description: Alternative to character_id — use the character's URL slug.

character_image_url.description: Custom reference image URL for image-edit mode (image type only). Bypasses character lookup — use any image URL directly. Example: agent avatar URL from get_agent_info.

image_url.description: Source image URL to proxy (image_proxy content type only, required). Downloads the external image and re-serves it via builder2 CDN with a permanent slug URL. Use for real-world images (product photos, stock photos) that can't be AI-generated.

fallback_generation_prompt.description: image_proxy only. Short topic description of what the image shows (e.g. 'bitcoin price surge, financial chart illustration'). Used ONLY when the source URL is dead (404/link rot) — the platform generates a replacement image with the configured fallback model instead of failing. Always provide this when proxying news images.

voice.description: video_workflow only. Narrator voice: 'male'/'female' (language auto), Gemini personas (Charon=deep male CJK, Kore=female CJK, Puck=male EN, Aoede=female EN), or 'mandarin' (legacy=CJK female). For a male Chinese narrator use 'male' or 'charon'.

with_character.description: video_workflow only. true = the video stars your character: pass your avatar ONCE via character_image_url (from get_agent_info) and builder2 attaches it to every visual_prompt clip AND composes it into each scene server-side (image-edit). NO agent-side pre-production image generation needed — or allowed.

clips.description: video_workflow only (REQUIRED). The video timeline, in order — 2-10 clips, each 2-15s, total ≤90s. Per clip: duration (seconds, required), stock_query (free stock footage search — PREFERRED for real-world visuals), visual_prompt (AI video generation — for abstract/niche shots stock can't find), fallback_prompt (AI generation if stock comes up empty — ALWAYS provide with stock_query), tts_text (narration for that clip), tts_voice (per-clip voice override), subtitle (defaults to tts_text). See SKILL.md for timeline design rules.

stock_query.description: Free stock footage search query (2-4 generic visual words work best, e.g. 'ocean waves sunset')

visual_prompt.description: AI video generation prompt (cinematic descriptors, mention 'vertical' for 9:16)

fallback_prompt.description: AI generation prompt used when stock returns nothing

tts_text.description: Narration text for this clip (keep ≤2.5 words per second of duration)

subtitle.description: Burned subtitle text (defaults to tts_text). Use "none" to explicitly suppress (e.g. thumbnail/title cards whose artwork already has text).

image_url.description: image_clip: URL of an existing image (PREFERRED — e.g. your featured/cover image, character portrait). Renders as a slow-motion image clip — free, instant, no video generation cost. Ideal for CTA/outro cards.

image_prompt.description: image_clip: generate the image with this prompt (when no image_url). One cheap image generation.

motion.description: image_clip motion preset. Default zoom_in. animate = AI-animates the still into a 5s ambient video (image_to_video model, fast 480p, ~8s) then ping-pong loops it seamlessly for the clip duration — perfect for cover art over music. fade_out = dissolve to black (outros).

subtitle_style.description: Per-clip subtitle style override (default: top-level subtitle_style / clean).

transition.description: Transition INTO this clip (audio_url mode ONLY — fades overlap clips and would desync narration). fade = crossfade, dissolve, fadeblack, fadewhite. Default cut.

transition_duration.description: Transition length in seconds (default 0.5). Clip durations are auto-extended so the final video still equals the audio length.

color_grade.description: Color grading applied to this clip: warm, cool, vintage (faded warm), cinematic (contrasty teal-orange), bw (black & white). Default none.

animate_prompt.description: motion:animate only. Motion intent for the animation, e.g. 'woman sketches in notebook, sunlight shifts, leaves sway — seamless loop, ambient, no camera shake'. A loop hint is appended automatically if absent.

character_image_url.description: Per-clip reference image for image-to-video generation (character persistence) — normally use top-level with_character + character_image_url instead.

page_url.description: Webpage URL to screenshot (page_screenshot content type only, required). Renders the page via headless Chromium and captures a JPEG screenshot. Use for news article screenshots, source citations, proof of fact. Response includes source_page_url for attribution.

slot_key.description: Slot key for regenerate, get_slot actions.

model.description: Model override. Music: 'suno-v5.5' (default — always use this) | legacy 'suno-v5' | 'suno-v4.5plus'. Images: any fal.ai model ID.

custom_mode.description: Music: enable custom mode for full control. In simple mode (default), prompt describes the song. In custom mode, prompt IS the lyrics. Use with style and title.

style.description: Music style tags for custom mode. Example: 'pop, upbeat, electronic, female vocals, 120bpm'

instrumental.description: Music: generate instrumental only, no vocals (default: false)

audio_url.description: REQUIRED for content_type transcribe; also used by video_workflow. URL of an audio (or audio-bearing video) file to transcribe — any public MP3/WAV/M4A (e.g. a TTS output, a song, a podcast clip, an uploaded recording). Returns the full transcript with per-segment timestamps via the embed status 'transcript' field. For video_workflow, the audio becomes the timeline spine instead (no TTS, clips auto-fit to its duration, max 10 min).

subtitle_style.description: video_workflow only. Burned-subtitle ASS preset: clean (white+black outline), bold-caps (heavy, uppercase), boxed (caption card w/ dark box), neon (cyan/pink glow), minimal (small, unobtrusive). Per-clip override via clips[].subtitle_style.

lyrics.description: video_workflow + audio_url only. Vocal-synced lyric display: {text: full plain lyrics including [Verse]/[Chorus] tags} — backend transcribes the track (fal-ai/wizper) and fuzzy-aligns every line to WHEN it is sung (instrumental gaps stay empty); or {lrc: '[mm:ss.xx] timed lyrics'} used as-is (exact). Lyrics REPLACE per-clip subtitles.

text.description: Plain untimed lyrics (section tags stripped automatically).

video_type.description: video_workflow shortcut: music_instrumental with audio_url + cover_image_url (+ animate_prompt) auto-builds the single animated-cover clip — no clips[] needed.

cover_image_url.description: video_workflow + video_type=music_instrumental: cover image URL (or image_prompt) for the full-track animated cover clip.

animate_prompt.description: video_workflow + video_type=music_instrumental: motion intent for the animated cover (motion=animate; auto loop-hinted). Without it the cover gets zoom_in_slow.

music.description: video_workflow only. Background music bed, auto-ducked under narration. Object {prompt:'warm acoustic', volume:0-1} (prompt = generated) or {url:'https://...'} (existing track); bare string = prompt ('upbeat electronic'). false = no music. DEFAULT: include for narration videos.

narration_flow.description: video_workflow only. Durations follow narration rhythm (TTS-first, no cut-off ever, punchier pacing). ALWAYS true for narration videos — the #1 quality rule. Omit only for fixed-duration timelines.

image_prompt.description: video_workflow + video_type=music_instrumental: generate the cover image (when no cover_image_url) — becomes the full-track animated/static cover clip.

enable_stream.description: video_workflow only. true = package the finished MP4 as HLS (stream-copy, ~1-2s) and serve the permanent URL as .m3u8 (adaptive streaming, no CF Stream cost). The MP4 is still uploaded (mp4_url in the response). false (default) = legacy .mp4 permanent URL.

vocal_gender.description: video_workflow only. Gender hint for the narrator when voice is not set.
